description: Line budgets for each module of apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/, recorded at the post-split sizes and checked by scripts/check_flow_module_budgets.py (run by 'uv run task lint'). A module may shrink but never grow past its budget. Lower a budget by hand after shrinking a module; add an entry at creation size for a new module and remove the entry of a deleted one.
